title: SrDesignEngineer/Technical Lead-Interior
jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Design Engineer/Technical Lead to drive the design and development of innovative automotive interior systems. This role requires a strong technical background, leadership capabilities, and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences within vehicle interiors. Job Description:
1. Lead the conceptualization, design, and development of complex automotive interior components and systems, including Instrument Panels, Consoles, Door Trims, Seating, Headliners, and Pillars.
2. Generate detailed CAD models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using advanced CAD software such as CATIA V5/V6 .
3. Drive the design process from initial concept through to production release, ensuring all design deliverables meet program timelines and quality standards.
4. Conduct comprehensive feasibility studies, packaging analysis, and clearance checks for interior components, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
5. Ensure manufacturing feasibility, assembly efficiency, and serviceability of all designed interior parts, applying DFM/DFA principles.
6. Act as a technical lead, providing guidance, mentorship, and technical support to junior engineers on design methodologies and best practices.
7. Collaborate closely with styling, packaging, CAE, manufacturing, and supplier teams to integrate design requirements and resolve technical challenges.
8. Participate actively in design reviews, present design solutions, and incorporate feedback to refine interior component designs.
9. Ensure all designs comply with relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and company-specific design guidelines.
10. Identify and implement innovative design solutions to enhance product performance, aesthetics, and cost-effectiveness. Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field. 3-10 years of progressive experience in automotive interior design and development. Expert proficiency in CAD software such as CATIA V5/V6 , including advanced surfacing and solid modeling capabilities. Strong understanding of automotive interior systems, materials, and manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, thermoforming, stitching, foaming). Demonstrated experience in Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles. Proficient knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and tolerance stack-up analysis. Proven ability to lead design projects, manage technical challenges, and mentor junior team members. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.  Why Join Us: This role offers a unique opportunity to lead critical interior design projects, contribute to cutting-edge automotive innovations, and grow your career within a dynamic and collaborative environment.
